endButton: Give SHIKATAGANAI Power Token to Sawtelle Spirit

dialogues.speaker: player
dialogues.text: YOU: What is this place?

dialogues.speaker: sachi
dialogues.text: SACHI: This is Ikkanda Automotive Service. My dad sometimes comes here for help.

dialogues.speaker: sachi
dialogues.text: Let's head inside.

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: TOM IKKANDA: Hi Sachi, good to see you again. What's going on today?

dialogues.speaker: sachi
dialogues.text: Hi Mr. Ikkanda! My dad's car is broken. He told me to ask you if you could take a look.

dialogues.speaker: sachi
dialogues.text: I think the brakes are worn down and he probably needs new tires.

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: Well, I'm afraid it's worse than that. The transmission is shot.

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: He won't be able to drive his car again.

dialogues.speaker: sachi
dialogues.text: Oh no! What will my dad think?

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: He'll need to accept it, even if it is painful.

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: Have you heard of SHIKATAGANAI? It means Acceptance of your situation.

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: Sometimes, no matter how much we want to change something, we just can't.

dialogues.speaker: sachi
dialogues.text: You mean, like learning to let go?

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: Exactly. During the war, many Japanese American families had to learn to let go.

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: Our communities were uprooted, our businesses closed.

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: Then, I ended up working in Reno, Nevada for the military.

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: I accepted my fate and tried to make the best of life during the war.

dialogues.speaker: sachi
dialogues.text: Sounds like you accepted what happened to you during the war.

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: Yes, acceptance gave me the strength to keep on going.

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: Not giving up, but finding peace with what we cannot change.

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: That is the lesson of SHIKATAGANAI.

dialogues.speaker: sachi
dialogues.text: Thank you, Mr. Ikkanda. That's a powerful lesson.

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: Please take this token.

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: SHIKATGANAI (Acceptance) can help you through difficult times.
